origin.description: Change environment variables until the frame exits. prefix joins with a space.

arguments.name: _new
arguments.text: Mapping of names to new values. None unsets.

origin.details: None unsets a variable. Duplicate names keep the last value. prefix and suffix join the new and old text with a space.
origin.value: The previous values, with None where a variable was unset.
origin.example:
Sys.setenv(WITHR_TEST_VAR = "old")
on.exit(Sys.unsetenv("WITHR_TEST_VAR"), add = TRUE)
inside <- local({
  local_envvar(c(WITHR_TEST_VAR = "new"), action = "prefix")
  Sys.getenv("WITHR_TEST_VAR")
})
c(inside, Sys.getenv("WITHR_TEST_VAR"))

translation.description: Change environment variables until the frame exits. prefix joins with a space.

arguments.name: _new
arguments.text: Mapping of names to new values. None unsets.

translation.details: None unsets a variable. Duplicate names keep the last value. prefix and suffix join the new and old text with a space. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.value: The previous values, with None where a variable was unset.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

os.environ["WITHR_TEST_VAR"] = "old"
with local_envvar({"WITHR_TEST_VAR": "new"}, action="prefix"):
    inside = os.environ["WITHR_TEST_VAR"]
after = os.environ["WITHR_TEST_VAR"]
del os.environ["WITHR_TEST_VAR"]
return [inside, after]
